ITEM 1 | Diced cubes of cooked light-colored meat with pale cream-to-off-white flesh and golden-tan edges, some pieces showing light browning, moist surface with slight sheen, cubes about 1.5-2 cm, piled in a loose mound in the upper-left center of a white square plate, interspersed with small yellow-green flecks | 110
ITEM 2 | Small diced pieces of pale yellow-green and light green vegetable with soft, slightly glossy texture, scattered among and beneath the cubed meat, about 0.5-1 cm pieces | 20
ITEM 3 | Small flecks of orange-red and tan seasoning or herb bits dispersed across the meat mound, dry and matte in appearance | 2
ITEM 4 | Bright green asparagus spears, about 8-9 spears, roughly 12-15 cm long and 0.8-1 cm thick, firm and straight with tight tips, lying in a fan on the lower-left of the plate, with slightly darker green at the stalk ends | 75
